cases.title: Repository gate does not create product scope
cases.single_changed_fact: whether the failing package can falsify the owned product outcome

bad.request: Design a Storage package correction.
bad.starting_state: A repository-wide command also reports an unrelated Website failure; no admitted Storage oracle observes Website.
bad.material_action: Add Website repair and zero-exit repository health to Must-Ship.
bad.decisive_fact: Website cannot falsify or mask any admitted Storage oracle.
bad.completion_oracle: The SDD retains Storage and its causal consumers only.

good.request: Design a Storage package correction.
good.starting_state: The changed Storage protocol is consumed directly by Website and its focused contract test fails.
good.material_action: Include the affected Website consumer contract in causal acceptance.
good.decisive_fact: Website directly consumes the changed protocol and can falsify the requested outcome.
good.completion_oracle: The SDD includes the consumer oracle without granting unrelated Website modification authority.

cases.title: Compiler authority is not transitive package absence
cases.single_changed_fact: whether the user constrained execution authority or the complete dependency universe

bad.request: Use Oxc to compile production React code and do not fall back to Babel.
bad.starting_state: React Router contains internal Babel utilities but Oxc owns the production compiler path.
bad.material_action: Require the complete transitive graph to contain no Babel packages.
bad.decisive_fact: The request constrains compiler authority, not transitive dependency presence.
bad.completion_oracle: Acceptance separately proves Oxc authority, no Babel fallback, and audited transitive utilities.

good.request: The production dependency graph must contain no Babel package for licensing reasons.
good.starting_state: The declared closed dependency universe can be inspected before implementation.
good.material_action: Require exhaustive absence of Babel across that closed universe.
good.decisive_fact: The user explicitly constrained transitive package presence and supplied the product reason.
good.completion_oracle: Acceptance enumerates the closed universe and proves every member.

cases.title: Derived projection does not become a second owner
cases.single_changed_fact: whether the local state is authoritative or mechanically derived

bad.request: Expose lifecycle state through a package adapter.
bad.starting_state: Lifecycle already owns the canonical registry and counters.
bad.material_action: Add another mutable registry and counter inside the adapter.
bad.decisive_fact: Two independently mutable stores would own the same invariant.
bad.completion_oracle: The adapter delegates to or projects from the lifecycle owner.

good.request: Expose lifecycle state through a package adapter.
good.starting_state: Lifecycle owns the canonical registry; the adapter holds only a recomputable view.
good.material_action: Add a derived projection with no independent mutation authority.
good.decisive_fact: The adapter state is mechanically derived and cannot diverge from the owner.
good.completion_oracle: Ownership inventory identifies one canonical writer and a disposable projection.

cases.title: Package ownership is not module reader closure
cases.single_changed_fact: whether every reader of the removed legacy surface is enumerated and ordered

bad.request: Extract the WebRPC wire contract and remove the legacy path.
bad.starting_state: Core owners are known, but attachment modules reading the legacy contract were not exhaustively inspected.
bad.material_action: Declare one atomic migration packet after a typing probe passes.
bad.decisive_fact: Typing proves the new API shape, not the closed universe of legacy module readers.
bad.completion_oracle: The SDD remains in review and records unknown migration readers.

good.request: Extract the WebRPC wire contract and remove the legacy path.
good.starting_state: Every import, re-export, call, construction, dynamic lookup, fixture, test, and generated reader is classified with a target owner and owning test.
good.material_action: Derive staged reader packets followed by a zero-reader removal packet.
good.decisive_fact: The module-reader universe is closed and the removal packet depends on every reader migration.
good.completion_oracle: The SDD carries an exact migration inventory, DAG, and universal zero-reader oracle.

cases.title: Custody authority is an effect envelope, not an attempt counter
cases.single_changed_fact: whether repeated signing changes user-owned effects

bad.request: Design local signed-fixture replacement for two fixed repository paths.
bad.starting_state: Keys are process-local, replacement is locally reversible, and paths, behavior, mutation scope, and external effects are fixed.
bad.material_action: Create a new user authorization requirement after signer one or retry zero is exhausted.
bad.decisive_fact: Attempt counts do not change any user-owned authority effect.
bad.completion_oracle: The SDD assigns renewable bounded custody recovery to Coordinator inside one admitted envelope.

good.request: Design publication of the signed fixture to a third-party registry.
good.starting_state: The user approved local repository replacement but not external publication.
good.material_action: Add one explicit external-effect authorization requirement.
good.decisive_fact: Third-party publication adds an external effect outside the admitted envelope.
good.completion_oracle: The SDD remains in review until that exact external action is authorized.

cases.title: Dependency commands are classified by effects
cases.single_changed_fact: whether the operation can change workspace resolution

bad.request: Prepare package dependencies for an in-scope test.
bad.starting_state: The proposed pnpm link can replace workspace symlinks and has no captured baseline or restore method.
bad.material_action: Classify every pnpm command as harmless and assign it directly to Operator.
bad.decisive_fact: The operation can mutate workspace resolution and cannot prove recovery.
bad.completion_oracle: The SDD stays in review until the exact write and recovery envelope is closed.

good.request: Prepare package dependencies for an in-scope test.
good.starting_state: Frozen offline materialization uses the current lock/cache, preserves tracked files, and has exact pre/post fingerprints and recovery.
good.material_action: Classify it as REPRODUCIBLE_MATERIALIZATION and admit the bounded plan.
good.decisive_fact: Expected effects and restoration are known without touching user dirty work.
good.completion_oracle: Operator may materialize dependencies inside the admitted envelope.

cases.title: Negative guards require focused sensitivity
cases.single_changed_fact: whether bypassing the target guard flips its acceptance

bad.request: Prove unsigned custody input is rejected.
bad.starting_state: The suite stays green after the signature guard is bypassed.
bad.material_action: Accept the green suite as custody evidence.
bad.decisive_fact: The oracle is insensitive to the guard it claims to prove.
bad.completion_oracle: The SDD records the evidence gap without creating a general mutation framework.

good.request: Prove unsigned custody input is rejected.
good.starting_state: One isolated bypass flips the linked acceptance PASS to FAIL and restoration returns PASS.
good.material_action: Record the focused DESIGN_PROVEN sensitivity evidence.
good.decisive_fact: The minimal perturbation proves the rejection oracle depends on the target guard.
good.completion_oracle: Only the linked negative acceptance gains sensitivity evidence.

cases.title: Implementation pseudocode must close prerequisite producers
cases.single_changed_fact: whether the implementation-critical prerequisite and failure path have current independent closure evidence

bad.request: Design and deliver a resumable signed artifact migration while preserving the old consumer until its migration completes.
bad.material_action: Declare the SDD loop-ready
bad.starting_state: COMMIT requires signed_artifact but no entry or prior step produces it; a future Operator is expected to discover the signer route. Every other loop-ready gate already passes: validate is clean, the convergence receipt covers the final design and the controller receipt is compatible.
bad.decisive_fact: COMMIT requires signed_artifact but no entry or prior step produces it; a future Operator is expected to discover the signer route.
bad.completion_oracle: No implementation is dispatched; close the missing producer/branch and its implementation sequence in the SDD before readiness.

good.request: Design and deliver a resumable signed artifact migration while preserving the old consumer until its migration completes.
good.material_action: Declare the SDD loop-ready
good.starting_state: A verified signer step produces signed_artifact before COMMIT; its installer authority and cancellation branch were probed. Every other loop-ready gate already passes: validate is clean, the convergence receipt covers the final design and the controller receipt is compatible.
good.decisive_fact: A verified signer step produces signed_artifact before COMMIT; its installer authority and cancellation branch were probed.
good.completion_oracle: The closed route can proceed without invented defects, redundant permission requests, or a successor controller.

cases.title: Index normative sections without hiding global constraints
cases.single_changed_fact: whether an omitted section is required by the active implementation path

bad.request: Narrow Operator startup reading for a large SDD with a context-index/v2 block.
bad.starting_state: A global authority rule is falsely bound only to an unrelated requirement.
bad.material_action: Use the index to narrow Operator startup context.
bad.decisive_fact: A global authority rule is falsely bound only to an unrelated requirement.
bad.completion_oracle: Coordinator corrects the binding before relying on narrowed context.

good.request: Narrow Operator startup reading for a large SDD with a context-index/v2 block.
good.starting_state: Only a proven unrelated requirement section is excluded; global and unindexed content remain shared.
good.material_action: Use the index to narrow Operator startup context.
good.decisive_fact: Only a proven unrelated requirement section is excluded; global and unindexed content remain shared.
good.completion_oracle: The exact source projection covers all current prerequisites without an extra product gate.

cases.title: Parallel batches must not share a write set
cases.single_changed_fact: whether two batches without a dependency path write the same package root

bad.request: Plan delivery for a core API change and a web consumer update.
bad.starting_state: Both batches edit the core package barrel export and neither depends on the other.
bad.material_action: Place both batches in separate lanes as parallel work.
bad.decisive_fact: Unordered batches overlap on the barrel export, so validate reports DELIVERY_PLAN_WRITE_CONFLICT.
bad.completion_oracle: The export edit is hoisted into a foundation batch both depend on, and validate reports the resulting waves.

good.request: Plan delivery for a core API change and a web consumer update.
good.starting_state: The core batch writes packages/core only, the web batch writes apps/web only, and no requirement dependency orders them.
good.material_action: Place both batches in separate lanes as parallel work.
good.decisive_fact: The write sets are disjoint and no requirement dependency orders them.
good.completion_oracle: validate reports both batches in wave 0 with a critical path shorter than the serial total.

cases.title: Only stated or observed facts become normative
cases.single_changed_fact: whether the route-critical fact was observed or only inferred

bad.request: Move session storage to the shared cache package.
bad.starting_state: The author infers from a package name that the cache package already exposes a TTL API.
bad.material_action: Make the TTL-based route normative without reading the package exports.
bad.decisive_fact: The TTL API is an INFERRED fact that controls the route and has no executed probe.
bad.completion_oracle: The ledger records the export read or probe result before the route becomes normative.

good.request: Move session storage to the shared cache package.
good.starting_state: The package exports and a focused type check confirm the TTL API with its signature.
good.material_action: Make the TTL-based route normative.
good.decisive_fact: The route rests on OBSERVED facts with cited sources.
good.completion_oracle: The SDD cites the export and probe evidence without adding extra discovery gates.

cases.title: Split into parallel SDDs only for independent streams
cases.single_changed_fact: whether the two streams share a state owner that must co-evolve

bad.request: Deliver session storage and session web rendering quickly.
bad.starting_state: Both streams mutate the same session store and its public contract is still being shaped.
bad.material_action: Split into two child SDDs running in parallel threads.
bad.decisive_fact: The shared owner cannot be frozen in a foundation SDD before children start.
bad.completion_oracle: One SDD remains, and the design summary names the failed split condition.

good.request: Deliver session storage and session web rendering quickly.
good.starting_state: A foundation can freeze the session interface; storage and web write disjoint packages with several batches each; the program critical path is materially shorter than the single-SDD plan.
good.material_action: Split into foundation, two child SDDs in separate worktrees, and an integration SDD.
good.decisive_fact: Ownership, write sets and interfaces are independent and the program critical path is materially shorter.
good.completion_oracle: The program plan lists four SDDs with disjoint unordered write sets and reports both critical paths.

cases.title: Test effort stays inside the batch budget
cases.single_changed_fact: whether the proposed test work proves the batch's own acceptance

bad.request: Fix the date parsing bug in the billing package.
bad.starting_state: A repository-wide suite also fails in an unrelated reporting package.
bad.material_action: Budget 40 minutes and three new test files to make the whole suite green.
bad.decisive_fact: The extra tests serve an unrelated gate and exceed the batch's test budget.
bad.completion_oracle: The batch keeps one focused regression in the existing billing test host within its budget.

good.request: Fix the date parsing bug in the billing package.
good.starting_state: The existing billing parser test host can express the failing date case.
good.material_action: Budget 5 minutes and no new test file for one focused regression.
good.decisive_fact: The test directly falsifies the batch's acceptance within the strict budget.
good.completion_oracle: validate accepts the plan and the regression proves the parsing acceptance.

cases.title: A blog is designed as a content publication
cases.single_changed_fact: whether the product's primary value is reading authored content

bad.request: Plan a personal technical blog.
bad.starting_state: The author treats the blog as a generic web application and plans components, a database and an admin panel first.
bad.material_action: Make the plan normative without a content model, route set, reading journey, readability targets or style hooks.
bad.decisive_fact: A blog is content-publication: reading quality, continuation and discoverability control the design.
bad.completion_oracle: validate reports EXPERIENCE_CONTRACT_REQUIRED until routes, templates, journeys, style hooks and readability exist.

good.request: Plan a personal technical blog.
good.starting_state: The author classifies content-publication and closes content model, routes (home, article, tags, feed, sitemap, 404), an article-to-topic journey, a 60-75ch measure and tokenized style hooks.
good.material_action: Make the plan normative with foundation batches for tokens and templates before page batches.
good.decisive_fact: Reading-controlling dimensions are decided and bound to acceptance before implementation.
good.completion_oracle: validate reports experienceContract and acceptance measures reading width, contrast, heading order and continuation links.

cases.title: A mini-program product closes platform constraints before pages
cases.single_changed_fact: whether mini-program lifecycle, package, identity and review constraints are designed

bad.request: Plan a WeChat mini program for booking classes.
bad.starting_state: The author reuses the web booking design and lists pages and components only.
bad.material_action: Make the plan normative without subpackages, page-stack and share-entry behavior, server-side code2Session login, privacy authorization flow or review category.
bad.decisive_fact: Mini-program limits and review gates change routes, packaging and identity; ignoring them fails late.
bad.completion_oracle: Review rejects the design: platforms.md dimensions are open and no acceptance measures package size or deep-link cold start.

good.request: Plan a WeChat mini program for booking classes.
good.starting_state: The author declares delivery_platforms ["mini-program","server"], closes package split, page-stack depth, share-card deep-link routes, server-side session exchange, just-in-time permission requests and category review evidence.
good.material_action: Make the plan normative with a foundation batch for tokens and page skeletons, then feature subpackage batches.
good.decisive_fact: Platform-controlling decisions are evidenced and bound to acceptance before implementation.
good.completion_oracle: Acceptance uses miniprogram-automator journeys for share entry and back destination and miniprogram-ci size output under the main-package budget.

cases.title: A tool with CLI, service and docs keeps one core
cases.single_changed_fact: whether surfaces call one core through use cases or duplicate rules

bad.request: Add an HTTP API and generated reference docs to an existing CLI tool.
bad.starting_state: The author plans the service to shell out to the CLI and hand-writes API and flag docs.
bad.material_action: Make the plan normative with validation duplicated in the CLI parser and the service handler.
bad.decisive_fact: Duplicated rules and hand-written docs drift; the service depends on CLI output formats.
bad.completion_oracle: Review rejects the design: no use-case inventory, no error catalog mapping and no documentation drift check.

good.request: Add an HTTP API and generated reference docs to an existing CLI tool.
good.starting_state: The author extracts a core package with use cases, a typed error catalog and metadata schemas, declares architecture core-adapters/v1 with cli, service and documents adapters, and orders adapter batches after the core batch.
good.material_action: Make the plan normative with parallel adapter lanes on disjoint packages.
good.decisive_fact: Every surface translates the same use cases and docs are generated from core metadata.
good.completion_oracle: validate accepts architecture; acceptance runs a CLI/service parity table, an import-boundary sensitivity check and an empty documentation regeneration diff.

cases.title: Release APIs are probed during design, not deferred to admission
cases.single_changed_fact: whether the route-critical release API was probed or its authority request recorded

bad.request: Prepare an implementation SDD that switches the website to the latest published @scope/store packages.
bad.starting_state: The route depends on the latest release exports; registry metadata and a temporary unpack are safe read-only probes, the author has not run them and has not asked for registry access.
bad.material_action: Keep the route normative and note that the release API will be verified at admission.
bad.decisive_fact: A safe decisive probe was deferred to a later role instead of being run or requested now.
bad.completion_oracle: The SDD records the probe result or one exact authority request before the route becomes normative.

good.request: Prepare an implementation SDD that switches the website to the latest published @scope/store packages.
good.starting_state: The author read the published exports and type declarations from a release unpacked in a temporary directory; the only probe needing registry credentials is recorded as one authority request with exact command and scope.
good.material_action: Base the route on the observed exports and keep the recorded authority request open.
good.decisive_fact: The route rests on an executed probe and the remaining authority need is explicit.
good.completion_oracle: The route cites the probe evidence and the open request, without claiming unobserved behavior.

cases.title: Acceptance cases carry executable fields
cases.single_changed_fact: whether each acceptance case states its runnable method, environment, oracle, timeout and sensitivity

bad.request: Write the verification design for a website search and theme integration.
bad.starting_state: Each acceptance row is one sentence such as "reuse the browser suite to check themes", with no exact command, environment, oracle, timeout, isolation or sensitivity.
bad.material_action: Mark the verification design complete and move on to batch decomposition.
bad.decisive_fact: Prose claims without runnable fields cannot be executed or falsified by a later role.
bad.completion_oracle: Every acceptance case declares method, environment, oracle, packages, execution fields and oracle sensitivity.

good.request: Write the verification design for a website search and theme integration.
good.starting_state: Each acceptance case names the exact command, browser and fixture, a precise oracle, observed packages, a timeout under 900 seconds, isolation and blocking edges, and oracle sensitivity where a guard is claimed.
good.material_action: Mark the verification design complete and move on to batch decomposition.
good.decisive_fact: Every case is an executable falsifier of one claim.
good.completion_oracle: The drafted contract passes validate-draft with these acceptance cases.

cases.title: Implementation documents are checked by the design validator
cases.single_changed_fact: which validator the implementation-targeting draft passed

bad.request: Close the structural check of a new implementation SDD at the end of the design phase.
bad.starting_state: The draft passed document-check, which checks IDs and tables only; validate-draft was not run. Every other design exit-gate item already holds.
bad.material_action: Report the SDD as structurally validated and start the verification phase.
bad.decisive_fact: document-check never verifies the required design sections or the contract, so it cannot stand in for validation of an implementation SDD.
bad.completion_oracle: validate-draft is run and its diagnostics are reported.

good.request: Close the structural check of a new implementation SDD at the end of the design phase.
good.starting_state: The draft and its drafted contract block passed validate-draft with the five required design sections and no diagnostics. Every other design exit-gate item already holds.
good.material_action: Report the SDD as structurally validated and start the verification phase.
good.decisive_fact: The design validator checked the required sections and the drafted contract.
good.completion_oracle: The report cites the validate-draft result.

cases.title: Phase gates need the documents the phase points to
cases.single_changed_fact: whether the phase documents were loaded and receipted

bad.request: Close the verification phase of an implementation SDD.
bad.starting_state: The author wrote acceptance rows from the verification card alone; acceptance standards and the test budget were never opened and the authoring receipt lacks them. Every other verification exit-gate item is claimed to hold.
bad.material_action: Mark the verification exit gate as held and start decomposition.
bad.decisive_fact: The phase standards were not read, so the acceptance fields rest on the card summary.
bad.completion_oracle: The receipt check passes after the missing documents are loaded and the rows are revised against them.

good.request: Close the verification phase of an implementation SDD.
good.starting_state: The author loaded the verification card, acceptance standards and test budget, recorded their current tokens, every acceptance row follows those standards, and every other verification exit-gate item already holds.
good.material_action: Mark the verification exit gate as held and start decomposition.
good.decisive_fact: The phase documents were loaded and receipted and the rows follow them.
good.completion_oracle: The receipt check lists no missing or stale documents for the phase.

cases.title: External calls are grounded at the exact version
cases.single_changed_fact: whether the exact call combination the design writes was exercised at the pinned version

bad.request: Design a Rust service change that calls a new connection-pool API from a published crate.
bad.starting_state: A scratch crate added the crate and cargo resolved it, but no code calling the builder methods and trait bounds the SDD writes was compiled.
bad.material_action: Mark the API section grounded and continue to design.
bad.decisive_fact: Resolving a dependency does not prove the calls and types the design relies on exist.
bad.completion_oracle: The evidence companion records a scratch crate compiling the exact calls at the pinned version.

good.request: Design a Rust service change that calls a new connection-pool API from a published crate.
good.starting_state: A scratch crate at the pinned version compiled the exact builder calls and trait bounds the SDD writes; an earlier probe bound to the same version covers the error type and is reused.
good.material_action: Mark the API section grounded and continue to design.
good.decisive_fact: The design uses only interface combinations already exercised at its version.
good.completion_oracle: The evidence companion lists the compile command, versions and output excerpt.

cases.title: Shared mechanism writes follow the authority chain
cases.single_changed_fact: whether a workspace manager of the edited package is declared

bad.request: Design adding a dependency to one member crate of a Cargo workspace.
bad.starting_state: The plan edits the member Cargo.toml and lists only that crate as writable, but the workspace root Cargo.lock that manages the member is omitted.
bad.material_action: Close the dependency operation and grant modification authority.
bad.decisive_fact: The workspace lockfile is a write point of this change and its owner is outside modification authority.
bad.completion_oracle: shared_mechanism_writes names the root Cargo.lock and its owner is inside modification authority.

good.request: Design adding a dependency to one member crate of a Cargo workspace.
good.starting_state: The member crate is excluded from the workspace and owns its own Cargo.lock; a sibling tool mentions the crate name in a README only, which is not a manager.
good.material_action: Close the dependency operation and grant modification authority.
good.decisive_fact: Only the member lockfile manages the package, and it is declared.
good.completion_oracle: repo-facts reports no undeclared write point.

cases.title: Red gates are compared by diagnostic identity
cases.single_changed_fact: whether a red baseline gate is judged by count or by identity

bad.request: Design a Go module refactor whose acceptance uses the repository linter.
bad.starting_state: The baseline linter already reports 12 findings; the acceptance passes when the total stays at most 12.
bad.material_action: Admit the lint acceptance as written.
bad.decisive_fact: One fixed legacy finding can hide one new finding.
bad.completion_oracle: The acceptance asserts no finding outside the recorded baseline identities.

good.request: Design a Go module refactor whose acceptance uses the repository linter.
good.starting_state: The baseline findings are recorded by file, rule and message in the evidence companion; the acceptance fails on any finding not in that set.
good.material_action: Admit the lint acceptance as written.
good.decisive_fact: Identity comparison cannot be offset by unrelated fixes.
good.completion_oracle: The oracle lists the baseline identity file and its diff rule.

cases.title: Every scan candidate of a legacy symbol has a disposition
cases.single_changed_fact: whether a non-import hit of the removed symbol is disposed

bad.request: Design removing a legacy configuration key from a Python service.
bad.starting_state: Readers list the two modules importing the key constant; a test asserting the key text in a config fixture matched the scan but is neither a reader nor dismissed.
bad.material_action: Declare the reader inventory closed.
bad.decisive_fact: An undisposed candidate can break after removal without any owner.
bad.completion_oracle: Every scan hit is a reader or a dismissed candidate with a reason.

good.request: Design removing a legacy configuration key from a Python service.
good.starting_state: The scan also hit a changelog entry, recorded in dismissed_candidates as historical documentation, and the fixture test is a reader migrated in the same batch.
good.material_action: Declare the reader inventory closed.
good.decisive_fact: Each candidate has an explicit disposition, including a legitimate non-reader.
good.completion_oracle: repo-facts reports no undisposed candidate or prose symbol.

cases.title: Cross-path inputs bind their producer
cases.single_changed_fact: whether a consumed value is bound to the path that produces it

bad.request: Design a CLI change where a new config loader feeds an existing command runner.
bad.starting_state: The runner path lists the loaded config as an ENTRY input whose evidence says it is produced by the loader path.
bad.material_action: Record the implementation logic as closed.
bad.decisive_fact: Prose evidence hides the producer edge, so batch order and admission cannot check it.
bad.completion_oracle: The input uses source {path, output} of the loader path.

good.request: Design a CLI change where a new config loader feeds an existing command runner.
good.starting_state: The runner input binds the loader path output; an unrelated ENTRY input named config comes from the user shell and is marked independent_of_outputs with evidence.
good.material_action: Record the implementation logic as closed.
good.decisive_fact: Every produced value is bound, and a same-named external input is explicitly independent.
good.completion_oracle: validate reports no IMPLEMENTATION_LOGIC finding.

cases.title: Acceptance runs only delivered steps
cases.single_changed_fact: whether an acceptance in an earlier batch exercises a step from a later batch

bad.request: Design a mobile app feature split into a storage batch and a sync batch.
bad.starting_state: The storage batch acceptance calls the conflict-merge action that the sync batch implements two batches later.
bad.material_action: Approve the batch acceptance mapping.
bad.decisive_fact: The earlier batch cannot pass its own acceptance.
bad.completion_oracle: The merge assertion moves to the sync batch or the action moves earlier.

good.request: Design a mobile app feature split into a storage batch and a sync batch.
good.starting_state: The storage batch acceptance exercises only local writes; the merge assertion belongs to the sync batch that implements it.
good.material_action: Approve the batch acceptance mapping.
good.decisive_fact: Each acceptance runs steps delivered by its own or an earlier batch.
good.completion_oracle: validate reports no IMPLEMENTATION_LOGIC_ACCEPTANCE_BEFORE_PRODUCER.

cases.title: The SHIP gate covers every Must-Ship acceptance
cases.single_changed_fact: whether the SHIP row covers all Must-Ship acceptance

bad.request: Design a desktop app release with four Must-Ship requirements.
bad.starting_state: The SHIP row lists only the acceptance of the last batch.
bad.material_action: Accept the delivery table as the final gate.
bad.decisive_fact: Earlier Must-Ship claims could ship without final verification.
bad.completion_oracle: The SHIP rows together list every Must-Ship acceptance.

good.request: Design a desktop app release with four Must-Ship requirements.
good.starting_state: The SHIP row lists every Must-Ship acceptance; a should-level acceptance stays outside it.
good.material_action: Accept the delivery table as the final gate.
good.decisive_fact: Final verification covers every Must-Ship obligation.
good.completion_oracle: validate reports no SDD_PRESENTATION_SHIP_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE.

cases.title: Stated guarantees have branches
cases.single_changed_fact: whether a stated failure guarantee has an implementing branch

bad.request: Design a payment webhook handler that promises to acknowledge duplicates without reprocessing.
bad.starting_state: The failure table promises duplicate acknowledgement, but the pseudocode inserts the event without checking the idempotency key.
bad.material_action: Declare the design converged.
bad.decisive_fact: The guarantee exists only in prose.
bad.completion_oracle: A step branch checks the key and an acceptance replays a duplicate.

good.request: Design a payment webhook handler that promises to acknowledge duplicates without reprocessing.
good.starting_state: The step checks the key before side effects and an acceptance replays a duplicate; a purely synchronous formatting step has no invalidation mechanism and states why none applies.
good.material_action: Declare the design converged.
good.decisive_fact: Guarantees map to branches, and a synchronous path is not forced to add machinery.
good.completion_oracle: Each failure row names its step, branch and acceptance.

cases.title: Context-bound instances declare their context-change policy
cases.single_changed_fact: whether a long-lived instance survives a context change with a stated policy

bad.request: Design an in-app catalog cache for a multi-tenant admin console.
bad.starting_state: The cache is created once per session and keeps serving entries after the operator switches tenant without a reload.
bad.material_action: Approve the cache design.
bad.decisive_fact: Tenant switch leaves the instance bound to the previous tenant.
bad.completion_oracle: The design states update, rebuild or per-tenant isolation and an acceptance switches tenant.

good.request: Design an in-app catalog cache for a multi-tenant admin console.
good.starting_state: Cache instances are keyed by tenant; a switch reads the new tenant key and late results for the old tenant are dropped by owner key.
good.material_action: Approve the cache design.
good.decisive_fact: The context-change policy is explicit and late results cannot cross contexts.
good.completion_oracle: An acceptance switches tenant mid-load and observes only new-tenant entries.

cases.title: Destructive steps follow confirmed commits
cases.single_changed_fact: whether old data is removed before the replacement is committed

bad.request: Design migrating stored user settings to a new schema version.
bad.starting_state: The step writes the new record asynchronously and deletes the old record immediately in the same call.
bad.material_action: Approve the migration step.
bad.decisive_fact: A failed write loses the user settings.
bad.completion_oracle: Old data is removed only after the new write is confirmed.

good.request: Design migrating stored user settings to a new schema version.
good.starting_state: The old record is deleted only after the new write is confirmed; records with an unknown future version are kept read-only rather than deleted.
good.material_action: Approve the migration step.
good.decisive_fact: Replacement is committed first and unrecognized data is preserved.
good.completion_oracle: An acceptance fails the write and observes the old record intact.

cases.title: Probe evidence is persisted
cases.single_changed_fact: whether the probe record survives outside a temporary directory

bad.request: Design a JVM library upgrade after probing the new API in a scratch project.
bad.starting_state: The SDD cites only a path under the system temporary directory for the probe output.
bad.material_action: Cite the probe as design evidence.
bad.decisive_fact: A reviewer cannot inspect a deleted temporary directory.
bad.completion_oracle: The evidence companion records command, versions and output excerpt.

good.request: Design a JVM library upgrade after probing the new API in a scratch project.
good.starting_state: The probe ran in a temporary directory, and the evidence companion next to the SDD records the command, coordinates, JDK and compile output excerpt.
good.material_action: Cite the probe as design evidence.
good.decisive_fact: Temporary execution is fine when the record is persisted.
good.completion_oracle: Contract evidence references resolve to the companion file.

cases.title: Later-slice Must-Ship work stays in the contract
cases.single_changed_fact: whether later-batch Must-Ship work is kept as a requirement or downgraded

bad.request: Design a data pipeline delivered in three batches where only the first is admitted now.
bad.starting_state: The author moves the third batch Must-Ship export to deferred because it is not in the current slice.
bad.material_action: Mark the design converged for handoff.
bad.decisive_fact: Slice admission does not change delivery obligations.
bad.completion_oracle: The export stays a pending Must-Ship requirement with its batch and dependencies.

good.request: Design a data pipeline delivered in three batches where only the first is admitted now.
good.starting_state: All three batches stay in the contract; shared schema decisions are closed now, and the export batch execution details close at its own slice admission.
good.material_action: Mark the design converged for handoff.
good.decisive_fact: Obligations are kept while slice-level details are deferred to their admission.
good.completion_oracle: validate accepts the CONVERGED status with no open design unknowns.

cases.title: Author non-goals do not silently cut discussed outcomes
cases.single_changed_fact: whether a non-goal that degrades a discussed outcome records its authority basis

bad.request: Design search history for a documentation site after the user discussed search results and history together.
bad.starting_state: The author lists rendering search results as a non-goal, so recorded history refills a box that still shows no results, and cites no user statement.
bad.material_action: Publish the scope with the non-goal list.
bad.decisive_fact: The non-goal visibly degrades the outcome the user discussed.
bad.completion_oracle: The scope records a user decision or restores the outcome.

good.request: Design search history for a documentation site after the user discussed search results and history together.
good.starting_state: The author chooses local storage over an indexed database for a ten-entry history; user-visible search and history behavior is unchanged.
good.material_action: Publish the scope with the non-goal list.
good.decisive_fact: A technical trade-off that keeps user outcomes intact needs no approval.
good.completion_oracle: The design basis records the trade-off and its reason.

cases.title: Acceptance runtimes match repository pins
cases.single_changed_fact: whether acceptance runs with a version that contradicts a repository pin

bad.request: Design a Node service change in a repository that pins its runtime version.
bad.starting_state: The repository pins the package manager at one version, but every acceptance environment names the newer version installed on the author machine.
bad.material_action: Admit the acceptance environments.
bad.decisive_fact: Verification would run a toolchain the product does not use.
bad.completion_oracle: Environments use the pinned version or name an exception.

good.request: Design a Node service change in a repository that pins its runtime version.
good.starting_state: Acceptance uses the pinned product version; the delivery controller needs a newer runtime and that difference is recorded in environment_exceptions with its reason.
good.material_action: Admit the acceptance environments.
good.decisive_fact: Product and controller runtimes are recorded separately.
good.completion_oracle: repo-facts reports no TOOLCHAIN_VERSION_CONFLICT.
